title: 第708章 让我放松一下筋骨第707章 泳衣还是不够清凉
slug: 我反派魔尊开局被清冷师尊强吻
content_zh:
上一次她来万灵谷时，生命之泉将她的肉身淬炼得更加坚韧，为后续的突破打下了坚实的基础。
而这一次再度浸泡，她发现那股温润的生命之力不仅再次强化了她的经脉与丹田，更在她识海深处荡开了一圈圈细密的涟漪。
那些她平日里练剑时反复琢磨却始终差了一线的剑道瓶颈，在生命之力的浸润下忽然变得清晰了几分。
甚至对于剑道的领悟都清晰了几分，她闭上眼，能在识海中看到自己挥剑的轨迹比以往更加流畅而精准，仿佛笼罩在剑意之上的最后一层薄纱被一股无形的力量轻轻揭开了。
她将肩上那条被温泉浸得半透明的薄纱披肩重新拢了拢，让它在自己肩头重新归位成一道优雅的褶皱。
然后似乎是想起了什么，她用满面好奇的目光看着江尘羽：
“那在泡完温泉过后，我们就直接出发去天火神凤所说的龙族秘境吗？”
“对的，等泡完温泉之后我们就去那边！”
江尘羽将擦干头发的浴巾从手中放下，随手挂在一旁的衣架上，然后转过身，用那双深邃的眼眸望向张无极。
“不过嘛，今天才泡了一天，肯定还是不够的！”
他话锋一转，那双眼眸里浮现起一抹只有他自己才知道的狡黠光芒，唇角也微微上扬，勾勒出一道意味深长的弧度。
“我觉得吧，再怎么着也得修养个四五天养精蓄锐完后再去秘境！”
江尘羽沉吟了片刻，抬起手伸出四根手指在身前晃了晃，随后又觉得四天似乎少了些，于是又加了一根，五根手指在他胸前轻轻摆动了几下。
荒之海峡那种险恶之地，空间乱流变幻莫测，上古荒兽潜伏于暗处。
再加上真龙遗迹中不知藏着多少未知的危险，若是没有将状态调整到最佳便贸然前往，那显然有些太过托大了。
四五天的时间说长不长说短不短，恰好够她们在生命之泉中将身体状态调整到巅峰，也恰好够他在出发前再好好享受几次与红颜们共浴的乐趣。
而听到这话，周围其余的红颜们倒是没有什么意见。
虽然在这生命之泉里边，江尘羽想欺负谁就欺负谁，那双邪恶的爪爪在水下神出鬼没，时而偷袭这个的腰侧，时而突袭那个的后颈，时而同时对付两三条尾巴，小日子过得实在是太滋润了一些。
但是嘛，她们也不抗拒这种被偷摸着欺负的感觉。
那种在众目睽睽之下、在其他姐妹们都近在咫尺的时候，被那只温热的手掌悄悄探入浴袍边缘、极轻极快地触碰一下某处敏感肌肤的感觉，带着一种在其他任何地方都感受不到的紧张与刺激。

她们表面上都维持着各自的从容与镇定，有的在闭目养神，有的在低声交谈，有的在品茶赏花，仿佛那只在水下兴风作浪的邪恶爪爪与她们完全无关。
但每个人心里都清楚，那只手随时可能落在自己身上，这份心照不宣的期待本身，便是一种极致的享受。
哪怕是谢曦雪，她也觉得在这种环境下贴贴能够给她带来一种在其他地方所感受不到的刺激与愉悦感。
在太清宗的寝殿里，她与江尘羽的每一次亲热都是私密的、从容的，只有两个人的空间里她可以放心地将自己交给他，不必担心被任何人看到或听到。
但在这里，在温泉氤氲的水雾中，当江尘羽的指尖极轻极缓地滑过她腰侧那条敏感的弧线时，她必须在第一时间绷紧身体、咬住嘴唇，将几乎要脱口而出的喘息硬生生地压回喉咙里。
因为就在她身旁不到三尺的位置，独孤傲霜正闭目养神，李鸾凤正端着茶杯品茶，诗钰和小玉正叽叽喳喳地不知在讨论什么。
这种随时可能被发现却又始终没有被发现的紧张感，与她体内被他指尖撩拨起的那股酥麻交织在一起，产生了一种让人上瘾的、在其他任何地方都无法复制的独特快感。
......
在泡完温泉过后，江尘羽并没有像其他红颜那样径直回到自己的房间。
谢曦雪要回房打坐调息，将方才在温泉中吸收的生命之力尽数炼化。
三位逆徒结伴去了万灵谷的坊市，说是要淘些蛮荒域特有的灵材。
至于其余的红颜嘛，她们也有自己的事情要处。
每个人都有各自的安排，每个人都有各自的去处，反倒是他这个将所有行程串联起来的人，忽然闲了下来。
......
夜色已深，万灵谷的栈道两侧悬挂的荧光石散发着柔和而清冷的光芒，将整座山谷映照得如同沐浴在月色之中。
content_en:
The last time she came to Ten Thousand Spirits Valley, the Fountain of Life had tempered her body even harder, laying a solid foundation for subsequent breakthroughs.
But after soaking again this time, she found that the warm life force not only strengthened her meridians and Dantian again, but also created circles of fine ripples in the depths of her sea of ​​consciousness.
Those bottlenecks in swordsmanship that she had pondered over and over again when practicing swordsmanship but were always missing, suddenly became a little clearer under the infiltration of the power of life.
Even her understanding of the way of the sword became somewhat clearer. She closed her eyes and could see in the sea of ​​consciousness that the trajectory of her sword swing was smoother and more precise than before, as if the last veil covering the sword's intention was gently lifted by an invisible force.
She gathered the gauze shawl that had been soaked in the hot springs translucently around her shoulders, and let it return to its original position into an elegant fold on her shoulders.
Then she seemed to remember something, and she looked at Jiang Chenyu with curious eyes:
"Then after taking a dip in the hot spring, shall we set off directly to the secret realm of the Dragon Clan that Skyfire God Phoenix mentioned?"
"Yes, we'll go there after taking a dip in the hot spring!"
Jiang Chenyu put down the towel he was drying his hair with and hung it on a clothes hanger nearby. Then he turned around and looked at Zhang Wuji with his deep eyes.
“But, I’ve only spent one day soaking today, and it’s definitely not enough!”
As soon as he changed the topic, a cunning light that only he knew appeared in his eyes, and the corners of his lips were slightly raised, outlining a meaningful arc.
"I think, no matter what, you have to recuperate for four or five days to recharge your batteries before going to the secret realm!"
Jiang Chenyu pondered for a moment, then raised his hand and waved four fingers in front of him. Then he felt that four days seemed to be missing, so he added another one and waggled five fingers gently on his chest a few times.
A dangerous place like the Strait of Desolation, where the space flow is unpredictable and ancient wild beasts lurk in the darkness.
In addition, there are many unknown dangers hidden in the True Dragon Ruins. If you rush there without adjusting your condition to the best, it would obviously be too much.
Four or five days is not a long time, not a short time. It is just enough for them to adjust their physical condition to the peak in the fountain of life, and it is just enough for him to enjoy the fun of bathing with the beauties a few more times before setting off.
After hearing this, the other beauties around him didn't have any objections.
Although in this fountain of life, Jiang Chenyu could bully whoever he wanted. Those evil claws appeared and disappeared under the water, sometimes sneaking up on this person's waist, sometimes attacking the back of that person's neck, and sometimes dealing with two or three tails at the same time. His little life was really a lot of fun.
But, they don't resist the feeling of being sneakily bullied.
The feeling of having that warm hand sneak into the edge of the bathrobe and touching a sensitive skin very lightly and quickly when the other sisters are so close in front of everyone, with a kind of tension and excitement that can't be felt anywhere else.
On the surface, they all maintained their own composure and calmness. Some were closing their eyes to relax, some were chatting in low voices, and some were drinking tea and admiring flowers, as if the evil claw making trouble underwater had nothing to do with them.
But everyone knows in their hearts that that hand may fall on them at any time. This tacit expectation itself is the ultimate enjoyment.
Even Xie Xixue felt that posting in this environment could bring her a sense of stimulation and pleasure that she couldn't feel elsewhere.
In the Taiqing Sect's dormitory, every intimacy she had with Jiang Chenyu was private and calm. In the space of only two people, she could safely leave herself to him without worrying about being seen or heard by anyone.
But here, in the mist of the hot spring, when Jiang Chenyu's fingertips slid very lightly and slowly over the sensitive arc of her waist, she had toAt the first moment, he tensed up his body, bit his lips, and forced the gasp that was almost coming out of his mouth back into his throat.
Because less than three feet away from her, Dugu Aoshuang was concentrating with her eyes closed, Li Luanfeng was holding a teacup and sipping tea, and Shiyu and Xiaoyu were chattering about something.
This tension of being discovered at any time but never being discovered was intertwined with the tingling sensation in her body stirred by his fingertips, creating a unique pleasure that was addictive and could not be replicated anywhere else.
...
After taking a bath in the hot spring, Jiang Chenyu did not go straight back to his room like other beauties.
Xie Xixue wanted to go back to her room to meditate and adjust her breath, refining all the life force she had just absorbed in the hot spring.
The three rebels went to the market in Wanling Valley together, saying they wanted to buy some spiritual materials unique to the wilderness.
As for the other beauties, they also have their own affairs to attend to.
Everyone has their own arrangements, everyone has their own destination, but he, the person who connected all the itineraries, suddenly became free.
...
It's dark at night, and the fluorescent stones hanging on both sides of the plank road in Wanling Valley emit a soft and cool light, reflecting the entire valley as if it's bathed in moonlight.
